pages.title: There Is a Hippo in My House
pages.creator: Upgamer
pages.description:
There Is a Hippo in My House is a point-and-click mystery built around an unexpected houseguest. Investigate why a hippo is in the house and work out how its presence connects to the people who lived there before.

Notes left around the mystery raise another question: who is writing them? The adventure follows your investigation into the previous owners, the hippo's intentions, and the messages, giving you several connected pieces of the same unusual story to unravel.

pages.title: Octobeer
pages.creator: Hapisoda Studio
pages.description: Throw mugs at flying enemies in Octobeer. Keep hits coming to build combos, earn enough coins to pay rent, and unlock mug styles as you survive more runs.

pages.title: The Boyfriend Makeover Game
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Let the boyfriend take over styling in The Boyfriend Makeover Game. Watch his makeup choices and see what he picks for a beach outing and a dinner look.

pages.title: Happy Food Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Connect matching food tiles in Happy Food Link. Use routes with at most two bends, and clear pairs that open a path to the tiles still on the board.

pages.title: Snake Duel
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Eat to grow in Snake Duel and try to outlast the other snakes. Keep enough room to turn and choose between a solo game and a two-player match.

pages.title: Mole Dig Clicker
pages.creator: Hilda Games
pages.description: Tap through dirt in Mole Dig Clicker. Use the upgrade buttons to improve the mole's progress and work toward the center of the world. Digging continues while you're away.

pages.title: Sniper Master
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Take shots while airborne in Sniper Master. Watch the target during your jump and time your shot before you land, adjusting your aim if the target moves.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fit pieces together in Puzzle Blocks. Choose between timed speed challenges, rescue missions, and free play when you want to build without the race against the clock.

pages.title: Block Cut Cleaner
pages.creator: Oblocze LLC
pages.description: Place triangular pieces to clear the field in Block Cut Cleaner. Check how each placement might create more blocks and use a booster when you need to change the layout.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Shoot bubbles into matching groups in Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels. Work through temple layouts and use the stats screen to compare your current run with earlier scores.

pages.title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shift desserts between shelves in Cake Sorting Deluxe. Group at least three matching cakes and look for what comes into view when you clear the ones in front.

pages.title: Color Cargo Puzzle Rush
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: Send boxes to cargo buses of the same color in Color Cargo Puzzle Rush. Check which deliveries can move first and sort each group to the right vehicle.

pages.title: Tony Archer
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rescue your friends in Tony Archer. Move through the area and use the weapons you find to deal with the gang keeping them captive.

pages.title: Grass Ranch
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Mow the fields in Grass Ranch. Look for patches you haven't cut yet and work through the ranch's tasks as you clear the grass.

pages.title: Sweet business of cats: cakes
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Run a cat bakery in Sweet business of cats: cakes. Manage the available slots and combine ingredients from the recipes to make different cakes for customers.

pages.title: Syder Hyper Drive
pages.creator: syderzone
pages.description: Take a vehicle through futuristic stunt routes in Syder Hyper Drive. Control the car with the left and right arrows and complete missions as you keep the run going.

pages.title: Monster Girls Back to School
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Pick school outfits in Monster Girls Back to School. Try different clothing combinations for the characters and choose what each one will wear on her return.

pages.title: Fashionista Avatar Studio Dress Up
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Design a character in Fashionista Avatar Studio Dress Up. Mix clothes, hairstyles, and accessories, then see how the choices fit together in the salon.

pages.title: Shoot The Bottle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Shoot bottles around an abandoned gas station in Shoot The Bottle. Move from one target to the next and see how many you can hit before time expires.

pages.title: Incredible Princesses and Villains Puzzle
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of royals and villains in Incredible Princesses and Villains Puzzle. Work through fifty layouts and expect more demanding arrangements as the levels go on.

pages.title: Ramp Car Jumping
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Launch a car off a ski jump in Ramp Car Jumping. Build speed on the ramp, see how far the car flies, and watch what it hits on landing.

pages.title: Princess Valentines Crush
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Get Elsa and Jack Frost ready in Princess Valentines Crush. Choose makeovers for their Valentine's party and help them take photos of their finished looks.

pages.title: Real High Stunt Car Extreme
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Drive through the main trials in Real High Stunt Car Extreme. Try the bonus tracks when you want more demanding jumps and a tighter margin for mistakes.

pages.title: Woodman Idle Tycoon
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Hire workers to earn income in Woodman Idle Tycoon. Spend coins to improve their output and merge coins as you build up the operation.

pages.title: Super Snappy Pet Hop
pages.creator: Gamebop
pages.description: Guide your pet onto the centers of jump pads in Super Snappy Pet Hop. Swipe side to side to build a combo and try the weekly tournament.

pages.title: Royal Siege
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Defend a castle against armies and dragons in Royal Siege. Choose among weapons such as catapults and cannons and aim at enemies before they reach the walls.

pages.title: Brave Adventure
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Find a way out of the castle in Brave Adventure. Jump with space, climb the stairs, and look for ways past the obstacles and the boss guarding the exit.

pages.title: CUTE CATS JIGSAW PUZZLE
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Solve twenty kitten pictures in CUTE CATS JIGSAW PUZZLE. Work through four groups of increasing difficulty and complete them all to open the picture gallery.

pages.title: Fruit Juices
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Send slices of fruit toward their destinations in Fruit Juices. Look at the fruit on the platform and plan the order so you can prepare the different juices.

pages.title: Jewel Halloween
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match pumpkins, monsters, and skeletons in Jewel Halloween. Look for groups of three or more and collect coins as you clear the Halloween layouts.

pages.title: Chain Cube: 2048 merge
pages.creator: CASUAL AZUR GAMES
pages.description: Launch numbered cubes in Chain Cube: 2048 merge. Match equal values so the cubes combine, and account for the way they bounce as you work toward 2048.

pages.title: Pet Match
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Match animals in Pet Match and work through the levels. Switch to the timed endless mode when you want to keep playing for a higher score.

pages.title: Random Stop
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Shoot the small white ball at the yellow one in Random Stop. Aim again after every shot because the yellow target moves to a new spot without warning.

pages.title: Adventure Quiz
pages.creator: Polar Games
pages.description: Answer questions to keep your adventurer going in Adventure Quiz. Expect topics ranging from music to countries and games, then try to climb the score rankings.

pages.title: Caitlyn Dress Up School
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Choose school clothes in Caitlyn Dress Up School. Try dresses or skirts and shirts, then pick shoes, accessories, and a hairstyle to finish Caitlyn's look.

pages.title: Two Circles
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rotate the rings in Two Circles so yellow balls reach yellow and white balls reach white. Watch both ends because the next ball can come from above or below.

pages.title: Fire Circle
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Hold to paint a circle in Fire Circle. Release when a white bar gets in the way and start again when it's safe to color the remaining area.

pages.title: Backflip Adventure
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Land flips on marked targets in Backflip Adventure. Time the rotation and try new parkour spots as they unlock, from city settings to a haunted house.

pages.title: Mad Warrior
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Collect gems and fight rivals in Mad Warrior. Use the left mouse button to attack or the right to sprint, and work through the character evolutions.

pages.title: Monsters Run
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Tap to jump in Monsters Run. Look ahead as the next obstacle comes into view and time the leap to keep your monster moving.

pages.title: Eliza Queen of Chess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style a chess champion in Eliza Queen of Chess. Try a dress, a suit, or a different combination to find what you want Eliza to wear.

pages.title: Owl Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot owls into groups of at least three matching ones in Owl Shooter. Work before the timer runs out and use a power-up when part of the board is hard to reach.

pages.title: Public Park Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two park pictures in Public Park Differences. Tap the details that change and look for at least five before moving to the next pair.

pages.title: Jungle Dash Mania
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run from a bear in Jungle Dash Mania. Jump over stumps, rocks, and traps, and pick up power-ups when they can protect you or help you pull ahead.

pages.title: Skincare Crush
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Match pairs of pictures in Skincare Crush. Remember where each image is and clear the board efficiently to work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Solitaire TriPeaks Garden
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play TriPeaks card layouts in Solitaire TriPeaks Garden. Clear cards in sequence and work through the levels with a cat companion as you fill out the garden.

pages.title: Fruit Paint
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Choose a fruit picture in Fruit Paint and give it your own colors. Work through one design, then try a different palette on another fruit.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Prepare a snow-themed dance in Princess Fashion Salon. Choose the princess's outfit and decorate the palace for the party she wants to hold after the first snowfall.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle Legend
pages.creator: ArcadeGears
pages.description: Drag hexagonal pieces into place in Hexa Puzzle Legend. Fill every square of the layout, and move from Beginner toward Expert as you try the 240 puzzles.

pages.title: Sports Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Build sports car pictures in Sports Cars Jigsaw. Use the car's body lines, wheels, and background colors to find the pieces that fit next to one another.

pages.title: Candy Floss Maker
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Make fairground sweets in Candy Floss Maker. Use the tools to prepare desserts for customers and work through each step of the food stall's orders.

pages.title: Woodturning 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Shape wood carefully in Woodturning 3D. Use the mouse or touchscreen to carve the piece, watching the shape as you make each pass.

pages.title: Yummy Popsicle Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match frozen treats in Yummy Popsicle Memory. Turn over two tiles and remember their positions, then clear the four layouts in as few moves as you can.

pages.title: Primary Math
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Practice addition and subtraction in Primary Math. Work through forty levels and check each answer as the numbers get harder to calculate.

pages.title: Background Color Tape
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap squares that match the flashing background in Background Color Tape. Wait for the right color and react quickly when the flashes come closer together.

pages.title: Janissary Battles
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play eight retro duels in Janissary Battles. Try to score five in contests with weapons such as bows, spears, and catapults as the game switches between them.

pages.title: Ice Princess Hidden Hearts
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find ten hidden hearts in each picture in Ice Princess Hidden Hearts. Check the six scenes carefully and click the hearts before time runs out.

pages.title: Transport Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive transport vehicles through rough routes in Transport Driving Simulator. Keep control over uneven ground and change your approach as the terrain differs between levels.

pages.title: Clock Shoot Game
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fire from one clock toward another in Clock Shoot Game. Wait for the hand to line up with a target, then press space or click Shoot.

pages.title: Extraordinary Limousine Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match pictures of long cars in Extraordinary Limousine Memory. Turn over the tiles two at a time and try to clear them without repeating guesses you've already made.

pages.title: Fancy Mustang Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two Mustang pictures in Fancy Mustang Differences. Select each change you find and take your time, since the game gives you an untimed search.

pages.title: Christmas Puppet Princess House
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Furnish a dollhouse for Annie and Eliza in Christmas Puppet Princess House. Arrange the furniture in rooms such as the bedroom and give each space its own look.

pages.title: Crazy Taxi Car Simulation Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Pick up passengers in Crazy Taxi Car Simulation Game 3D. Drive the yellow taxi along city streets and winding mountain roads while keeping track of the route.

pages.title: Birth of Jesus Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six Nativity images in Birth of Jesus Puzzle. Choose from four piece counts and use shapes and details in each scene to find where the pieces belong.

pages.title: Tap Tank
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap to change a tank's direction in Tap Tank. Gather diamonds and steer clear of boxes, since a collision takes you back to the beginning.

pages.title: Stickman Street Fighting 3D
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Fight through city streets in Stickman Street Fighting 3D. Pick up weapons such as a pistol or saw and use them against the stick fighters in your path.

pages.title: Dots VS Dots
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hit a small dot with a larger one of the same color in Dots VS Dots. React when the small dot changes color and try to keep the round going.

pages.title: Slide Block Fall Down
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Slide blocks sideways in Slide Block Fall Down to fill gaps in a row. Complete a line to clear it and make space for more moves.

pages.title: House Wall Paint
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Paint the white areas in House Wall Paint. Use the arrow keys to move along each surface and work out which direction reaches the remaining unpainted spots.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Dolphin Tour
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Visit the dolphin park in Baby Hazel Dolphin Tour. Watch the performances with Hazel's family and help her take part when she gets to interact with the dolphins.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Classic
pages.creator: TopFrivGames
pages.description: Time jumps past obstacles in Geometry Dash Classic. Click or tap when an opening comes up and use the layout to judge how early the next jump needs to be.

pages.title: Toy Car Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Turn over tiles to remember the car pictures in Toy Car Memory. Match identical images until the board is clear and use earlier flips to help with the remaining pairs.

pages.title: Fun Airplanes Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rebuild twelve aircraft illustrations in Fun Airplanes Jigsaw. Choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece layout and match outlines, colors, and wing details.

pages.title: Handless Millionaire 3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Reach past a sharp blade for a bill in Handless Millionaire 3. Wait for an opening, grab the money, and pull back before the blade comes down.

pages.title: Circuit Drag
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Time your turns in Circuit Drag. Use the mouse to control the car as you approach bends, and aim to keep it moving around the circuit.

pages.title: BTS Animals Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a drawing in BTS Animals Coloring Book. Choose colors with the brush and fill the picture, then try another animal with a new palette.

pages.title: Mr Spark
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Get the character into water before he explodes in Mr Spark. Examine each setup and work out which move sends him to safety before time runs out.

pages.title: Falling Ball
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Click to jump in Falling Ball. Time each jump around what is in your path and see how far you can guide the ball through the course.

pages.title: Fancy Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble car pictures in Fancy Cars Jigsaw. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and take as much time as you like to find how the pieces fit.

pages.title: Piano Tiles
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Follow the moving keys in Piano Tiles. Use the mouse to hit the piano tiles as they arrive and try to keep up as the sequence continues.

pages.title: Bonnie Rocker Chick
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give Bonnie and her friends rock-inspired looks in Bonnie Rocker Chick. Try streaked hair and edgy pieces such as a skull-print top as you style the group.

pages.title: Girl Dress up & Dishwashing
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Choose clothes and a hairstyle in Girl Dress up & Dishwashing. Browse dresses, skirts, or jeans to make an outfit, then try the dishwashing activity.

pages.title: EG Bus Subway
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Run through the subway in EG Bus Subway. Swipe to move past hazards and jump between trains as you keep ahead of the inspectors.

pages.title: Kindergarten Dress Up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress several babies for school in Kindergarten Dress Up. Pick clothes and costumes for each one, then give them toys to take along.

pages.title: Wordy Night
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Build words from the pieces in Wordy Night. Choose English, German, or Japanese and use a hint if you can't place a piece in the current layout.

pages.title: Monkeys Ropes Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Race to the top of a tree in Monkeys Ropes Party. Control a small lemur and watch the other climbers as up to four people compete on one screen.

pages.title: Pyramid Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Look for treasure inside a pyramid in Pyramid Party. Move through the rooms before your rivals get there and play with up to four people or computer opponents.

pages.title: Romantic Royal Couple
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Dress the princess and prince for an evening together in Romantic Royal Couple. Choose clothes and hairstyles for both and see how the finished looks go together.

pages.title: Candy Time
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Link three or more matching sweets in Candy Time. Make chains of four or five for bonus candy and score enough points to reach the next level.

pages.title: Paper Blocks Hexa
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Fill the hexagonal outlines in Paper Blocks Hexa. Drag the colored pieces where they fit and collect stars to open additional puzzle packs.

pages.title: Ellie Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat Ellie's skin in Ellie Skin Doctor. Work through the rashes and wounds with tools including lasers and cooling equipment as you complete her emergency-room visit.

pages.title: Secret Office Kissing
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Wait for the boss to look away in Secret Office Kissing. Take the chance to kiss and stop before the boss turns back toward the couple.

pages.title: Hollywood Superstar Make Up!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Try the latest beauty looks with Ellie in Hollywood Superstar Make Up! Pick makeup combinations for her Hollywood trip and see how each choice changes the final look.

pages.title: Horse Racing
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Choose a horse and place a virtual bet in Horse Racing. Watch the runners after the start and see whether the horse you picked finishes first.

pages.title: Super Stars Fashion Boutique!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Browse a new shop in Super Stars Fashion Boutique! Find dresses in the sale and help the friends choose pieces they want to take home.

pages.title: Make Your Own Cosmetic Brand Spil
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Create a lipstick in Make Your Own Cosmetic Brand Spil. Choose the shade, flavor, and other ingredients, try adding glitter, and design a package for your finished product.

pages.title: Silly ways to die: Christmas Party
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep the holiday characters out of trouble in Silly ways to die: Christmas Party. React to the dangers in each festive scene and see how many creatures you can protect.
